subject: Heal
text: The Heal spell reduces defense to 0 until the game is paused.

evidence.quote: The Heal spell reduces your Defense to 0 (as if you're Moogled) until the next time you pause the game.

subject: Will
text: Casting a spell with a fully charged Will bar acts as a damage multiplier and deals quadruple damage.

evidence.quote: Also, Will acts as a damage multiplier - casting a spell with a fully charged Will bar deals quadruple damage.

subject: Will
text: Leveling up Will increases Wisdom but grants no physical attack power.

evidence.quote: Leveling up Will grants some Wisdom but no physical attack power, so fully charged Nukes deal insane damage.

subject: Level Up
text: Gaining a level up completely refills your MP.

evidence.quote: The linchpin to the strategy in this guide is the fact that getting a level up refills your MP.

subject: Hero
text: The player character begins the game with 2 points in each stat.

evidence.quote: 0       N/A     You start the game with 2 of each stat.

subject: Watts
text: Silver Armor can be purchased from Watts.

evidence.quote: 11      Wisdom  Buy Silver Armor from Watts.

subject: Jadd
text: Gold Armor, Gold Helmet, and Gold Shield can be purchased in Jadd.

evidence.quote: 18      Wisdom  Buy Gold Armor, Gold Helmet, and Gold Shield in Jadd.

subject: Ish
text: Flame Armor can be bought in Ish.

evidence.quote: 24      Will    Buy Flame Armor in Ish.

subject: Kary
text: A Will stat of 35 is recommended to fight Kary.

evidence.quote: 26      Will    Now you have 35 Will, which you need to fight Kary.

subject: Dragon Armor
text: Dragon Armor is found inside Dime Tower.

evidence.quote: 32      Will    Find the Dragon Armor in Dime Tower.

subject: Jackal
text: Jackal is fought twice in the prologue before falling down the waterfall.

evidence.quote: BOSS: Jackal ... Go N, E, Up, W ... BOSS: Jackal ... Go W ... - Get knocked down Waterfall.

subject: Goblin
text: Goblins take 2 hits to kill, give 1 experience point, and drop Candy which sells for 2G or restores 8 HP.

evidence.quote: Goblins require 2 hits, while Mushbooms requrie 1. ... Both give only 1 experience point. ... Goblins drop Candy, which is worth 2G to sell or 8 HP when used.

subject: Girl
text: Talking to Hasim after defeating the Mushbooms rescues the Girl and allows you to use Ask to heal.

evidence.quote: Kill the Mushbooms, then talk to Hasim (the injured man) ... You can now use "Ask" to heal, if necessary.

subject: Imp
text: Imps take 3 hits to defeat with 1 level up, or 2 hits with 2 level ups, while Rabites take 1 hit.

evidence.quote: Imps take 3 hits to kill if you have only 1 level up, or 2 if you have 2. ... Rabites take only 1 hit to kill.

subject: Bogard
text: Bogard lives in a house in the Waterfalls area where a chest can be taken after talking to him 3 times.

evidence.quote: Talk to Bogard 3x ... Go N ... - Take Chest.

subject: Waterfall Cave Shop
text: The shop past Waterfall Cave sells the Battle Axe and Key for 165G total.

evidence.quote: Enter the shop with 165G. ... Buy Battle Axe, Key.

subject: Flower
text: Flowers in the Marsh die in a single hit, while Marmablues take 2 or 3 hits.

evidence.quote: Flowers die in a single hit.  Kill them, but ignore their treasure. ... Marmablues die in 2 or 3 hits.  Avoid them if you can.

subject: Cure
text: Sleeping in the bed at Kett's teaches you the Cure spell, but the Girl is lost.

evidence.quote: Sleep in bed. ... You will learn Cure but lose the Girl.

subject: Lizardman
text: Lizardmen take 2 or 3 hits to kill, drop Cure potions, and yield the Bronze Key needed to unlock the Marsh Cave door.

evidence.quote: Defeat the Lizardmen to get the Bronze Key. ... Lizardmen will take 2 or 3 hits to kill. ... Lizardmen drop Cure potions.  Take up to 2. ... Equip the Bronze Key to enter this door.

subject: Floating Fish
text: Floating fish in Marsh Cave deal heavy damage and drop Mattocks.

evidence.quote: Floating fish drop Mattocks, and you need at least one Mattock drop (or an extra trip to the item shop) to get through Kett's. ... Floating fish deal a LOT of damage.  Use Cure liberally.

subject: Marsh Cave Button
text: Pushing the button after taking the stairs down makes a new stairway appear.

evidence.quote: Go N, W, Down ... - Push button to make stairs appear.

subject: Ivy Chest
text: A chest surrounded by ivy can be taken, and the ivy is cleared using the Sickle.

evidence.quote: * This room has a chest surrounded by Ivy. ... - Take Chest, then use Sickle to cut Ivy.

subject: Skeleton
text: Skeletons deal high damage and can be farmed for Keys in almost any dungeon.

evidence.quote: Skletons deal a lot of damage, and aren't worth much experience. ... If you run out of Keys, you can farm Skeletons in almost any dungeon.

subject: Bubble Ghost
text: Bubble Ghosts are immune to most weapons, but can be farmed for Mattocks in later dungeons.

evidence.quote: Bubble Ghosts are not vulnerable to most weapons.  In later dungeons, they can be farmed for Mattocks if you run out.

subject: Hidden Stairway
text: A rock past the sickle path conceals a hidden stairway that must be broken open with a Mattock.

evidence.quote: Go W, N, N(Sickle), E, Down ... - The rock conceals a stairway; Mattock it.

subject: Stairway Buttons
text: Press the top button, then use two Mattocks to reach and press the second button to make the stairs appear.

evidence.quote: Go W, S, E(K), Down ... - Press the top button, then use two Mattocks to reach the second button to make the Stairs appear.

subject: Hydra
text: Hydra inflicts up to 13 damage, and mashing the Attack button after taking a hit extends your invincibility time.

evidence.quote: BOSS: Hydra ... Hydra deals up to 13 damage; keep your HP above that. ... Mash the Attack button to extend your invincibility after being hit for an abnormally long time.

subject: Hydra Room Chests
text: After opening the first chest in Hydra's room, attack it to access the second chest.

evidence.quote: - Take chests ... Attack the first chest after opening it to reach the second.

subject: Werewolf
text: Equip the Mirror and Axe and speak to the butler to fight Werewolf, who deals about 10 damage and dies in 4 Axe hits.

evidence.quote: BOSS: Werewolf ... Equip Mirror and Axe, and talk to butler. ... Werewolf deals about 10 damage, and may hit you right at the start. ... 4 Axe hits will kill him.

subject: Owl
text: Owls drop Crystals, while Zombies drop Ethers or Wisdom Crystals.

evidence.quote: Owls drop Crystals, while Zombies drop Ethers or Wisdom Crystals.

subject: Zombie
text: Zombies can be destroyed with the Fire spell or with 2 hits from a Mattock.

evidence.quote: Zombies can be killed with Fire, or with 2 Mattocks if you are desperate.

subject: Mice
text: Owls, Pumpkins, and Mice all die to either 2 weapon hits or 1 cast of Fire.

evidence.quote: Owls, Pumpkins, and Mice all die to either 2 weapon hits or 1 Fire cast.

subject: Urn Button
text: Break the urn with a Mattock to press the button that makes stairs appear.

evidence.quote: Press button (use Mattock to bust urn) to make the stairs appear.

subject: Chain Chest Trap
text: Take the Chain from the chest and use it to escape the trap.

evidence.quote: Go E, N, N(K) ... - Take Chain, then use it to escape the trap.

subject: Balcony
text: Traversing the balcony in Kett's requires the Chain weapon.

evidence.quote: * This is the balcony. ... Go W, W(Chain), S(leaves balcony)

subject: Chest Switch
text: Push the chest onto the button to reveal the stairs.

evidence.quote: Push the chest on the button to make the stairs appear.

subject: Basement Urn
text: Use a Mattock on the urn to reveal the staircase down.

evidence.quote: Go Down ... - Mattock the Urn to reveal the stairs.

subject: Girl
text: Behind the locked door, the Girl is positioned in the bottom row, 3 spaces from the left.

evidence.quote: Go E, S(K) ... - The Girl is in the bottom row, 3 from the left.

subject: Vampire
text: Attack Vampire with Fire while he moves and strike him from below with the Chain while he stops, destroying his incoming bats.

evidence.quote: BOSS: Vampire ... Attack with Fire while he's moving. ... Attack from a distance below him with the Chain while he's standing still. ... Your Chain should destroy the bats as they approach.

subject: Moblin
text: Moblin-like enemies require either 2 Fire spells or 1 Fire plus 1 or 2 Chain hits.

evidence.quote: The Moblin-esque enemies either require 2 Fires or 1 and a Chain hit or two.

subject: Bee
text: Bees are dangerous and should be eliminated with Fire before walking past them.

evidence.quote: Bees are dangerous.  Kill them with Fire before walking by.

subject: Heal
text: Following the cutscenes with Cibba and Julius in Wendel, you learn the Heal spell.

evidence.quote: - Keep going North until Cibba cutscene. ... - Keep going South until Julius cutscene. ... You will learn Heal.  Heal sets your defense power to 0 until the next time you pause.

subject: Wendel Inn
text: Rest at the Inn in Wendel to restore your MP.

evidence.quote: Go S, S(exits interior), S(enters town), S, Door (enters Inn) ... - Sleep in Inn to recover MP.

subject: Crab
text: Crab enemies drop Nectar.

evidence.quote: - Get at least 1, hopefully 2 Nectars from the Crab enemies.

subject: Silver Mine Entrance
text: From outside the shop, head north using Chain and Axe to cut a path to the door of the Silver Mine.

evidence.quote: Go S(Exits shop), N, N(Chain), N, N(Axe), W(Axe) ... Cut a path East, then North to the clearing, then West, North, West to your destination. ... Use Door (Enters Silver Mine)

subject: shop
text: Buy Oil, 2x Key, and 2x Mattock here.

evidence.quote: Buy Oil, 2x Key, and 2x Mattock here.
